capabilities: Trigger actions by pressing a set of keys at once
Paste the contents of a file
disambiguation: Not a hotkey manager; it works by text replacement, so chords are letters typed together rather than modifier-key bindings.
extras: Works through text replacement; the README advises backing up the vault before installing. Chords can be limited to notes or also work in other text fields, and disabled chords or groups do not count as duplicate triggers.
intentEvidence: Key sequence shortcut - Limited to commands.
problem: Frequent commands, templates and repeated text normally need modifier-key hotkeys or menu navigation to trigger.
summary: Triggers text insertion, file or template pasting, or command execution when a set of keys is pressed simultaneously.
